cases.name: scripts registered
cases.check: the target model's local tool catalog contains steward-infra, steward-observe, steward-context, steward-gate, steward-apply, steward-verify, steward-release, steward-brain and steward-lane-report
cases.why: command lanes invoke by toolId, resolved per model; a missing entry fails at fire time

cases.name: charter seeded once
cases.check: p-steward-charter holds one token with charterId steward; a reinstall does not add a second
cases.why: seeds are templates; a place that already holds a token keeps it

cases.name: the person is asked first
cases.check: after install and one observe, p-steward-prompts holds a prompt in goal mode and nothing else moved
cases.why: every iteration ends in a question; with an empty goal the first one asks for it

cases.name: the lane report lanes are running
cases.check: after install, t-steward-lane-report-cmd and t-steward-lane-report-daily are RUNNING or DEPLOYED and neither is in ERROR; t-steward-lane-report-daily is scheduled '0 10 6 * * *' Europe/Berlin (06:10, ten minutes after the digest)
cases.why: a lane that is not running looks installed and never fires; the daily request is the only thing that reaches the report without a person

cases.name: a request renders the newest observation
cases.check: writing {toolId: steward-lane-report, argv: [report], env: {MODEL_ID: steward}} as a command token to p-steward-lane-report-cmd makes t-steward-lane-report-cmd fire and leaves one token in p-steward-lane-report with kind 'lane-report', a non-empty markdown table and a lanes array whose entries match one row each of the newest p-steward-lanes observation; p-steward-lane-report never holds more than 10 tokens
cases.why: the report must be exactly what steward-observe measured, and a place a lane writes daily has to stay bounded

cases.name: the gate refuses the protected set
cases.check: a spec whose touches name t-steward-gate-cmd lands in p-steward-refused with a reason, never in p-steward-decisions
cases.why: the Steward improves every net except the ones that govern it

cases.name: a bad version rolls back
cases.check: a spec whose verification fails leaves the model on the previous pack version and the run marked rolled-back
cases.why: every change is a pack version and the previous one is the rollback
